topic: WhatsApp Business integration — how client requests flow into a tracked case instead of a group chat
format: Lead with a quote or question from a customer, then explain the feature built in response
post:
"Approved in the chat" isn't a paper trail. It's a liability.

That's a real message. Sent on a real Monday morning. Probably yours.

Here's what actually happens: a client or employee sends a request over WhatsApp, it drowns under 40 other messages, someone screenshots it, someone else assumes it's handled. Nothing gets tracked. Nobody owns it.

SmartPRO Hub fixes this.

When a request comes in through WhatsApp Business, it doesn't land in a group chat. It goes straight into a tracked case inside the platform — assigned to a team member, timestamped, tied to that employee or client record. Every follow-up, update, and resolution stays in one place.

No screenshots. No chasing. No "I thought you handled it."

PRO services teams and Sanad office managers in Oman tell us this one change cut their response time in half. When every request has an owner and a status, things get done. Simple as that.

WhatsApp stays as the channel. SmartPRO Hub is the system behind it.

If your team is still running requests through group chats, that's the place to start.
